06b59c392ff7.en: **987** — The scientist Gabiro standardizes the Darfaries interface verbs.
06b59c392ff7.t: **987年**——科学家加比罗将达尔法里斯界面的动词标准化。

10df9848b1c8.en: **~50,000–10,000 B.G.** — Southern Finaies specialize into three new races: the **Fuhraies** (cold peaks), the **Lishies** (meat-eating forest brutes) and the **Buhraies** (blood drinkers near today's Tolerideme). They fight over territory.
10df9848b1c8.t: **约50,000–10,000 B.G.**——南方的菲奈斯分化为三个新种族：**弗莱斯**（寒冷的山峰）、**利希斯**（吃肉的森林蛮族）和**布莱斯**（住在今天托勒里德梅附近的饮血者）。他们为领地而战。

22168b6fa0f6.en: **~855 B.G.** — Sabotage at Bahyum plus attacks from Lishies and humans. The Buhraies **unchain the Wood People** (pull the fost stones from their crowns) and they kill everything. The Buhraies cast a spell on the moon that fails, then flee west. Humans learn to wall villages with paralyzed Wood People.
22168b6fa0f6.t: **约855 B.G.**——巴休姆遭到破坏，加上利希斯和人类的进攻。布莱斯**解开了伍德皮普尔的锁链**（拔掉它们树冠上的福斯特石），它们杀光了一切。布莱斯对月亮施了一道法术，失败了，随后向西逃走。人类学会了用被麻痹的伍德皮普尔给村庄筑墙。

24f978d9c721.en: **0 A.G.** — **Ganyrami falls** to Machado's flank attack. The ancient species are put to the sword. The calendar starts here.
24f978d9c721.t: **0 A.G.**——**加尼拉米陷落**于马沙多的侧翼进攻。古代物种惨遭屠戮。历法从这里开始。

270837d5f8a3.en: **~800s** — Forway nearly bans freehand interface casting; by the 900s only fringe scientists still try it.
270837d5f8a3.t: **约800年代**——福威几乎禁止了徒手画界面施法；到900年代，只有边缘科学家还在尝试。

3fb1d9ff44d4.en: **~250–270 A.G.** — Inside the mountain, the **Darfaries** (born of Lishies and Buhraies) kill every other species — and burn their own history. The first king, **Gandew**, builds the **Goodbye Cliff** to launch Wozefaries and Sorefaries babies away. A bandit chief raises them in the oasis: **Flatland** is born.
3fb1d9ff44d4.t: **约250–270 A.G.**——在山中，**达尔法里斯**（由利希斯和布莱斯所生）杀死了其他所有物种——还烧掉了自己的历史。第一位国王**甘杜**修建了**再见崖**，把沃泽法里斯和索雷法里斯的婴儿发射出去。一位强盗头子在绿洲里把他们养大：**弗拉特兰**由此诞生。

41e586319129.en: **~6,000–5,000 B.G.** — The Buhraies raise the **Buhraies Plains**, a 2 km-high plateau, to escape the Lishies (fost stones form in the process; Lukewarm Lake is dug out).
41e586319129.t: **约6,000–5,000 B.G.**——布莱斯为了躲避利希斯，抬升出2公里高的高原**布莱斯平原**（福斯特石在这个过程中形成；温水湖也被挖了出来）。

43d11c83ddcb.en: The Buhraies create **Big Wingas**, **Wood People** (from Yabuca trees) and **Fanchakis**; discover **Walking Heart** stones (~2,450 B.G.); terraform **Endlessfog** and summon the **Bruntos**. The Lishies take Endlessfog (~2,100 B.G.).
43d11c83ddcb.t: 布莱斯创造了**大温加**、**伍德皮普尔**（用亚布卡树）和**凡查基**；发现了**沃金哈特**石（约2,450 B.G.）；改造了**恩德莱斯福格**的环境，召来了**布伦托斯**。利希斯夺取了恩德莱斯福格（约2,100 B.G.）。

4e07617293ed.en: **270–380 A.G.** — Another ancient group raises **Sundeath** and summons humans, who rebel and free the city.
4e07617293ed.t: **270–380 A.G.**——另一群古代种族建起**桑德斯**并召来人类，人类起义，解放了这座城市。

5b0ca63317a8.en: **Before ~100,000 B.G.** — The **Finaies** evolve in the far north, then spread south and reshape the land.
5b0ca63317a8.t: **约100,000 B.G.之前**——**菲奈斯**在极北之地进化，然后向南扩散，改造了大地。

5b129b763ae1.en: **671** naming schema · **680** the **Prosperity Treaty**, common currency, Vraki calendar and units; embassies founded; ruins and major cities handed to Forway. Sundeath resists, but gives in and keeps its Pharaohs. **705** essential goods section.
5b129b763ae1.t: **671年** 命名规范 · **680年** **繁荣条约**、通用货币、弗拉基历法和度量单位；大使馆成立；遗迹和主要城市移交福威。桑德斯起初抵抗，最终让步，保住了法老。**705年** 生活必需品条款。

64ece88d43b8.en: *From Blood Bag to Cattle* · *Fanged Love* · *Biology of the Darfaries, Wozefaries and Sorefaries* (450 A.G.) · *Avenger of Twenty* · *The Sapphire Counter* (an accountant who hoarded balls like a dragon) · *Logical Arrow* · *The Smart Ladies* · *The True Sanbi King* · *Freekish Triangle Love* · *Ganyrami Flanker* · *Gabiro Sundeath Scientist Presents: A Deeper Dive into Buhraies' Soul Analysis* · *Poisoner* · *The Gone Road* · *Strong Walking Heart* · *Prosperity Treaty's Heroes I & II* · *Cleansing the Lone Mountain* · *Gandew's Way of Life* · *1000 Ways to Kill & Butcher Beasts*.
64ece88d43b8.t: *从血袋到牲畜* · *獠牙之爱* · *达尔法里斯、沃泽法里斯与索雷法里斯生物学*（450 A.G.） · *二十人的复仇者* · *萨菲尔会计*（一个像龙一样囤球的会计） · *逻辑之箭* · *聪慧女士们* · *真桑比王* · *弗里基什三角之恋* · *加尼拉米侧翼兵* · *桑德斯科学家加比罗献上：深入剖析布莱斯的灵魂分析* · *投毒者* · *消失的道路* · *强大的沃金哈特* · *繁荣条约的英雄们 I & II* · *净化孤山* · *甘杜的生活之道* · *杀死并肢解魔兽的1000种方法*。

66c1696df7f0.t: **1015年**——伊塔吉巴加冕为桑比国王。

66e55a9c9026.en: **~2,100 B.G.** — The Buhraies summon or create **humans ("Naked Bruntos")** on their plateau, teach them Vraki, mix in their blood, and hunt them for sport — frightened blood tastes sweetest.
66e55a9c9026.t: **约2,100 B.G.**——布莱斯在他们的高原上召唤或创造了**人类（“光溜溜的布伦托斯”）**，教他们弗拉基语，把自己的血混进去，还猎杀他们取乐——受惊的血最甜。

687875e5b50d.en: **120–680 A.G. (the Greed Period)** — The founders' heirs fight endless wars; Walking Hearts return to the armies. ~150 Whiteland is found; ~420 Newland; ~470 Sanbi builds **Waterfall** to flood Tolerideme; ~490 Old Fuhrair becomes a mining town; **570** Tolerideme marches on Gandew and a three-kingdom war begins — refugees swell Endlessfog, Triangle, Freeish, Blood and Deltacross; **572** Tolerideme blows up the South Dip road; **575** the **Cruros** appear (a drunk robed figure walked into the Tastyleaf swamp saying he had "a literal awesome fucking idea").
687875e5b50d.t: **120–680 A.G.（贪婪时代）**——建国者的继承人们打着无休止的战争；沃金哈特重回军中。约150年发现怀特兰；约420年发现纽兰；约470年桑比修建**沃特福尔**来淹没托勒里德梅；约490年老弗莱尔成为矿镇；**570年**托勒里德梅进军甘杜，三国战争爆发——难民涌入恩德莱斯福格、特赖安格尔、弗里伊什、布拉德和德尔塔克罗斯；**572年**托勒里德梅炸毁南坡的道路；**575年**出现了**克鲁罗**（一个穿长袍的醉汉走进泰斯蒂利夫沼泽，说他有“一个真他妈绝了的主意”）。

6bb9525a4a79.en: Most history before Ganyrami was word of mouth, the Darfaries burned their own, and the Greed Period lost a lot more. Historians disagree — use that.
6bb9525a4a79.t: 加尼拉米之前的历史大多是口口相传，达尔法里斯烧掉了自己的历史，贪婪时代又丢失了更多。历史学家们意见不一——好好利用这一点。

7ca2ade830b3.en: **640 A.G.** — **Freeish Paulin** builds a secret rebel base where Forway now stands. **648** — betrayed and sold to Gandew; the Gandew king is won over, executes Paulin publicly to save face, and carries on his plan. **650** — the courtroom scientists **Asa the Powerful**, **Adrian from North Tolerideme** and **Bijura Moacir** conspire. The people turn; all three kings fall (Gandew's executed calmly, Tolerideme's starved, Sanbi's spanked in public and dropped in the sea).
7ca2ade830b3.t: **640 A.G.**——**弗里伊什·保林**在如今福威所在之处建了一座秘密的反抗军基地。**648年**——他遭到背叛，被卖给甘杜；甘杜国王被说服，为了保住面子公开处决了保林，然后继续执行他的计划。**650年**——宫廷科学家**阿萨·帕瓦富尔**、**北托勒里德梅的阿德里安**和**比茹拉·莫阿西尔**密谋。民众倒戈；三位国王全部倒台（甘杜国王被平静地处决，托勒里德梅国王被饿死，桑比国王被当众打屁股后扔进海里）。

95d862b3d15d.en: **998** — Freeish's Village Competition ends in a brawl; never held again.
95d862b3d15d.t: **998年**——弗里伊什的村庄大赛以一场群殴告终；此后再未举办。

95ec43c11985.en: **1039** — A soul experiment at Sanbi Castle explodes; a stranger wakes in a bloodied tower (the events of the light novels). **Flingas are seen flying in winter**, which hasn't happened in a long time.
95ec43c11985.t: **1039年**——桑比城堡的一次灵魂实验发生爆炸；一个陌生人在一座血迹斑斑的塔里醒来（轻小说中的事件）。**有人看到弗林加在冬天飞翔**，这种事已经很久没发生过了。

997f6a392d5e.en: **~3,575 B.G.** — Lishies–Buhraies war. **~3,150 B.G.** — the Great Sea War: the Finaies invade by sea and fail. **~2,650 B.G.** — a Buhraies desert attack on the north fails.
997f6a392d5e.t: **约3,575 B.G.**——利希斯与布莱斯之战。**约3,150 B.G.**——大海战：菲奈斯从海上入侵，失败了。**约2,650 B.G.**——布莱斯从沙漠进攻北方，失败了。

9cbb1193bce6.en: **~5,215 B.G.** — The Finaies sacrifice their army to rain irradiated meteors down, creating **Hifuna**, a barrier between north and south. They later make a pact with the **Flingas** to watch the south.
9cbb1193bce6.t: **约5,215 B.G.**——菲奈斯牺牲自己的军队，降下带辐射的陨石，造出了隔开南北的屏障**希富纳**。后来他们与**弗林加**立约，让它们监视南方。

be8e8785e001.en: **~1,500–855 B.G.** — The Buhraies build **Bahyum**, an automated army factory that "always had a life of its own".
be8e8785e001.t: **约1,500–855 B.G.**——布莱斯建造了**巴休姆**，一座自动化的军队工厂，它“一直有自己的生命”。

d80e2a9c95f2.en: **~1,650 B.G.** — Humans weaken the plateau's **East Dip** until it collapses and escape — into the jaws of the Lishies, who farm them as cattle for centuries. Some flee south and found **Endlessfog** and **Triangle**.
d80e2a9c95f2.t: **约1,650 B.G.**——人类不断削弱高原的**东坡**，直到它塌陷，然后逃了出去——却正好落入利希斯的血盆大口，被当作牲畜饲养了好几个世纪。有些人逃往南方，建立了**恩德莱斯福格**和**特赖安格尔**。

daeccf0f2f58.en: **939 B.G.** — Humans steal **Walking Hearts** from the Buhraies (legend: *Strong Walking Heart*). Heroes rise and burn out (*Avenger of Twenty*, *Logical Arrow*).
daeccf0f2f58.t: **939 B.G.**——人类从布莱斯手中偷走了**沃金哈特**（传说：*强大的沃金哈特*）。英雄们崛起又燃尽（*二十人的复仇者*、*逻辑之箭*）。

e99da6c8cc54.t: 世界中的书籍（绝佳的分发材料）

ee9335281da4.en: Humans turn the Lishies against each other: **~805 B.G.** Aldemeri burns; **~525 B.G.** Lishin (today's Forway) falls; **~495 B.G.** the last ancients flee into the desert and, with the Fuhraies, raise the mountain that becomes Gandew. **~438 B.G.** nari stones discovered; **~338 B.G.** nari gels (first used as poisons).
ee9335281da4.t: 人类挑动利希斯自相残杀：**约805 B.G.** 阿尔德梅里被焚；**约525 B.G.** 利欣（今天的福威）陷落；**约495 B.G.** 最后的古代种族逃进沙漠，与弗莱斯一起抬升出后来成为甘杜的山。**约438 B.G.** 发现纳里石；**约338 B.G.** 发现纳里凝胶（最初被当作毒药）。

f7f0d8e82f00.en: **1040s** — *The West March campaign.* What happened in the novels is rumor and gossip; the DM decides the rest.
f7f0d8e82f00.t: **1040年代**——*西境战役。* 小说里发生的事只是传闻和八卦；其余的由DM决定。

fdcf726ff313.en: **0–120 A.G. (Indulgence)** — Peace through emptiness. Villages become cities; great adventurers found **Sanbi** and **Tolerideme**. ~60 A.G.: a young fisher makes a pact with the **True Sanbi King** fish. ~97 A.G.: humans fail to take the desert mountain.
fdcf726ff313.t: **0–120 A.G.（放纵时代）**——因空旷而来的和平。村庄变成城市；伟大的冒险者们建立了**桑比**和**托勒里德梅**。约60 A.G.：一个年轻渔夫与**真桑比王**这条鱼立下契约。约97 A.G.：人类没能夺下沙漠里的那座山。
